title: [GMCP 203.015.M] Mastery: MCP Apps extension and secure interactive UI
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-015-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP hosts and consumes the stable MCP Apps extension end to end: resources and tool results can declare trusted UI metadata, render in a sandboxed surface, call permitted tools, update state, and degrade to accessible non-visual content. CSP, origin isolation, permissions, accessibility, lifecycle, version negotiation, hostile app content and cross-app data separation pass the official extension suite and browser security tests. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
